content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Raebareli Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies for the Junior Resident post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is MBBS (including completion of Internship) or an equivalent degree recognized by MCI.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 37 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Pay Matrix (Level-10) with a minimum of Rs.56,100/- + NPA.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview date?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview date is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The venue is Medical College, AIIMS, Raebareli (UP).

faq.question: Q9. Is State/MCI Medical registration mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, State/MCI Medical registration is mandatory before joining.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.
